meta.title: Terms of Service · Ziwei Natal Chart
meta.description: Terms of service and user agreement for Ziwei Natal Chart

overview.heading: 1. Service Overview
overview.body: Ziwei Natal Chart (the “Platform”) provides natal chart calculation and reading services based on the Ziwei Doushu (Purple Star Astrology) system in Ni Haixia’s Tian Ji. All astrological content on the Platform is for reference only and does not constitute any medical, investment, legal or psychological counseling advice, or advice on major life decisions.

conduct.heading: 2. User Conduct
conduct.intro: By using the Platform, you agree:
conduct.lawfulUse: to use the Platform only for lawful, personal reference purposes
conduct.noRedistribution: not to distribute the Platform’s content for commercial sale, reposting or public release
conduct.noDisruption: not to engage in any conduct that disrupts the Platform’s normal operation
conduct.truthfulBirthInfo: that the birth information you submit is true and valid; the Platform is not responsible for inaccurate readings caused by incorrect information

ip.heading: 3. Intellectual Property and Restrictions on Use
ip.ownership: Original text and interface design on this site are protected by copyright. The charting engine comes from an open-source project and is used under its open-source license; the classics are public-domain Ming dynasty editions, presented here as modern summaries.
ip.scraping: (1) scrape this site’s content with crawlers, automated scripts or bulk API calls;
ip.training: (2) use readings, text or API responses generated by this site to train machine learning models;
ip.resale: (3) resell content generated by this site.
ip.penalty: If you breach these terms, we reserve the right to take legal action.

disclaimer.heading: 4. Disclaimer
disclaimer.accuracy: The Platform’s astrological content is compiled from knowledge of traditional Ziwei Doushu and Ni Haixia’s system, and is not guaranteed to be 100% accurate. Destiny is influenced jointly by the Three Powers of heaven, earth and humanity, and the Platform’s output serves only as a reference for understanding yourself. Users should view it rationally and should not rely too heavily on any single astrological judgment.
disclaimer.liability: The Platform bears no legal liability for any consequences arising from the use of its content (including but not limited to mistaken decisions, psychological effects and changes in relationships).

changes.heading: 5. Service Changes and Termination
changes.body: The Platform reserves the right to adjust, suspend or terminate some or all of its services at any time. Users will be notified of major changes by on-site announcement or email.

law.heading: 6. Governing Law and Dispute Resolution
law.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the People’s Republic of China. If a dispute arises, the parties shall negotiate amicably; if negotiation fails, the dispute shall be resolved through litigation in the people’s court with jurisdiction in the place where the Platform’s operating entity is located.

contact.heading: 7. Contact
contact.body: If you have any questions, please contact customer service via the WeChat account / email address published on the Platform.

meta.title: Privacy Policy · Ziwei Natal Chart
meta.description: Privacy policy for Ziwei Natal Chart

collect.heading: 1. Information We Collect
collect.intro: To build your chart and write its reading, this site handles the following information:
collect.chart: Birth details: a name (optional), date of birth in the Gregorian calendar, time of birth, gender and place of birth. The chart is calculated in your browser. Only when you save a chart do we store its name and these details on our servers, encrypted.
collect.account: Account: you sign in with GitHub. We store your GitHub account ID, the name and avatar GitHub shares, your email if GitHub shares it, and your role on the site. If you create an API key, we store only its name, its first few characters and a hash, never the key itself.
collect.questions: Questions and conversations: what you type into the reading panel. On a saved chart, your conversation with the AI is stored with the chart, encrypted. If you share a chart with a practitioner, the messages you exchange in that consultation are stored on our servers too.
collect.analytics: Usage statistics: Vercel Analytics and Speed Insights record anonymous page views and performance data, without cookies that identify you.

use.heading: 2. How We Use Information
use.chart: Birth details are used to build your chart, write its reading, and show a saved chart again when you open it. They are not used for anything else.
use.analytics: Anonymous usage statistics are used only to improve the site.

sharing.heading: 3. Information Sharing and Third Parties
sharing.intro: When you choose to share a saved chart with a practitioner, they can see that chart, including its birth details, and your consultation messages until you stop sharing it. Apart from that, we give your information to third parties only in these cases:
sharing.hosting: Service providers: Vercel serves the site and provides the anonymous usage statistics above, Neon hosts the database that holds saved data, and GitHub handles sign-in. To limit request rates, the site counts requests by account, IP address and API key, and keeps those counts for at most a day.
sharing.ai: AI service Anthropic (Claude): when you ask for a reading, the site sends it the structure of your chart (the stars and Four Transformations in the twelve palaces, the Five Phases Configuration, your current age and decades) and your questions, to write the reading. It does not send your date or time of birth, your gender or your name.
sharing.authorities: Lawful requests from judicial authorities or government departments under laws and regulations

security.heading: 4. Information Security
security.body: The whole site uses HTTPS. Saved birth details and your conversations with the AI are encrypted in our database with AES-256-GCM, and API keys are stored only as hashes. No transmission or storage can be guaranteed to be 100% secure.

rights.heading: 5. Your Rights
rights.local: Local preferences: your theme and language preferences live only in your browser; clearing the site’s data deletes them.
rights.server: Your saved data: on My charts you can see every chart you saved and delete any of them; deleting a chart also deletes its conversation, its shares and their consultation messages. You can’t delete your account in the app yet; to have it deleted, contact us through the details in section 7 of the Terms of Service.

cookies.heading: 6. Cookies and Local Storage
cookies.body: The site uses one sign-in cookie (authjs.session-token) to keep you signed in, for up to 30 days, and keeps two preferences: day or night theme (in your browser’s local storage) and interface language (the NEXT_LOCALE cookie, kept for a year). It uses no tracking cookies. Clearing them signs you out and returns the site to its defaults.

minors.heading: 7. Minors
minors.body: The Platform’s astrological content is intended for adult users aged 18 and over. Minors should use it with their guardian’s consent and must not use readings for major life decisions.

changes.heading: 8. Changes to This Policy
changes.body: This policy may be updated from time to time. We will give prominent notice of major changes. Continuing to use the Platform means you agree to the updated version.
